defs.def: everything you can see when you look across a large area of land, especially in the country （陆上，尤指乡村的）风景，景色

ex.s: To make some of my landscape shots, I have traveled up to four hours away to shoot within a 10-minute time frame.
ex.t: 为了拍摄我的一些风景照，我曾驱车长达四小时，只为在十分钟的时间窗口内拍摄。

ex.s: How does the author deal with the challenge as a landscape photographer in the Midwest?
ex.t: 作为中西部的一名风景摄影师，作者是如何应对这一挑战的？

ex.s: “These pollinator-friendly solar farms can have a valuable impact on everything that’s going on in the landscape,” says Macknick.
ex.t: "这些传粉昆虫友好的太阳能农场可以对景观中发生的一切产生有价值的影响，"麦克尼克说。

ex.s: Here, you can see dramatic landscapes.
ex.t: 在这里，你可以看到壮丽的景观。

ex.s: It has a complex landscape that includes great gorges, waterfalls and caves systems, pockets of rainforest and a large variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 它拥有复杂的地貌，包括大峡谷、瀑布和洞穴系统、零星的热带雨林以及种类繁多的野生动物。

ex.s: He did field research across China and studied more than a thousand rivers and streams, along with the landscape, history and culture of the surrounding areas.
ex.t: 他在中国各地进行了实地研究，研究了1000多条河流和溪流，同时研究了周边地区的景观，历史和文化。

defs.def: a painting of a view of the countryside; this style of painting 乡村风景画；乡村风景画的风格

ex.s: The landscape that lines the route is beautiful and dramatic, with snowy mountains and green valleys.
ex.t: 沿途的风景美丽而壮观，有雪山和翠绿的山谷。

ex.s: You can also bike along lovely landscapes outside of Amsterdam.
ex.t: 你也可以在阿姆斯特丹以外美丽的风景中骑行。

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.
ex.t: 尽管中西部的风景往往大同小异，不是农田就是公路，但有时我会在丘陵或湖泊中发现独特的韵味。

ex.s: What is the key to successful landscape photography according to the author?
ex.t: 根据作者的说法，成功的风景摄影的关键是什么？

defs.def: the way of printing a document in which the top of the page is one of the longer sides （文件的）横向打印格式

chunks.en: local / lovely / complex / dramatic / successful landscape
